What verification covers: every record's hashes recompute and each record
links to the one before it, so no record was edited, removed, inserted or
reordered without re-sealing everything after it. What it does not cover:
whoever controls the file can rewrite and re-seal all of it; records cut off
at the end of the journal are not detectable without an anchor outside it; the
context fields of the records (site, line, device, host) are not covered by
any hash, so this report does not show them; and nothing in a journal shows
that the values were true.
